_comment: Map UI key (dotted path into the `maps` translation tree) -> Hunt game
localization key (ui_*). build_i18n.py resolves each game key in every
language pak and writes the result into huntmap/i18n/ui.json.
Only add a pairing when the game string genuinely means the same thing.
Judge it by the ENGLISH VALUE, not the key name: ui_monsters_bears really
does read 'Brutes', and is the correct pairing despite what it is called.
Plural forms are preferred here because these labels head filter rows.
Precedence when the app builds a language:
English base < manual translations < these game strings < overrides.json
so a pairing added here replaces a hand-written translation, and anything
Run `python tools/build_i18n.py --suggest` to see candidate game keys
matched by English text, then hand-pick from those.
